Third-party visual assets used by Kind Kingdom

Hero sprites:
- File: `grafxkid-rpg-assets.png`
- Source: https://opengameart.org/content/rpg-character-sprites
- Creator: GrafxKid
- License: CC0

Pet sprites:
- Files: `tiny-creatures/tile_0032.png`, `tile_0121.png`, `tile_0122.png`, `tile_0130.png`, `tile_0179.png`, `tile_0180.png`
- Source: https://opengameart.org/content/tiny-creatures
- Creator: Clint Bellanger, compatible with Kenney Tiny style assets
- License: CC0

These assets were selected because they are permissive, lightweight, and work cleanly in Phaser as pixel-art sprites.
